docs.title: VulnGrid Handbook
docs.text:
End-to-end showcase of a full Application Security / DevSecOps pipeline: ingest findings from SAST/SCA/DAST tools, enrich with EPSS, risk-score with CVSS × EPSS, gate pull requests, and auto-create remediation tickets.

Start with:

  • OWASP Top 10 – cheat sheet used by the dashboard
  • CWE Mappings – common CWEs produced by the scanners
  • Secure SDLC Checklist – gates and ownership per phase

docs.title: CWE Mappings
docs.text:
Common CWEs emitted by the scanner wrappers:

CWE Name OWASP Top 10 Example remediation CWE-78 OS Command Injection A03 Injection Avoid shell=True; whitelist input CWE-89 SQL Injection A03 Injection Parameterized queries / ORM CWE-79 Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) A03 Injection Output-encode, use safe templating CWE-798 Hardcoded Credentials A07 Auth Failures Vault / env secrets, rotate keys CWE-918 SSRF A10 SSRF Allow-list URLs, no internal access CWE-502 Deserialization of Untrusted Data A08 Integrity Sign payloads, avoid pickle CWE-434 Unrestricted File Upload A04 Insecure Design Validate type/size, store outside webroot

Risk score used everywhere: risk = CVSS × EPSS × 10 (0–100). Gate threshold in CI: fail when CVSS ≥ 7.0 and EPSS ≥ 0.2.

docs.title: OWASP Top 10 (2021)
docs.text:
# Category Description 1 Broken Access Control Users can access resources they shouldn't. 2 Cryptographic Failures Weak or missing encryption. 3 Injection SQL, OS command, NoSQL, etc. 4 Insecure Design Missing security design patterns. 5 Security Misconfiguration Default credentials, open ports. 6 Vulnerable & Out-of-Date Components Use of libraries with known CVEs. 7 Identification & Authentication Failures Weak password policies, session fixation. 8 Software & Data Integrity Failures Untrusted libraries, supply-chain attacks. 9 Security Logging & Monitoring Failures No audit trails, no alerts. 10 Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Untrusted URLs are fetched by the server.

The dashboard visualises any finding that maps to these categories using the CWE ID.

docs.title: Requirements
docs.text:
• [ ] Security requirements captured alongside functional ones
  • [ ] Threat model for new data flows (owner: architect)

docs.title: Design
docs.text:
• [ ] Threat modeling reviewed (STRIDE)
  • [ ] AuthN/AuthZ design approved

docs.title: Implementation
docs.text:
• [ ] SAST (Checkmarx/Fortify/SonarQube) clean or triaged
  • [ ] SCA (Snyk/Black Duck) – no Critical CVEs with EPSS ≥ 0.2
  • [ ] Secrets scanning – no hardcoded credentials

docs.title: Verification
docs.text:
• [ ] DAST (ZAP/Burp) scan on staging
  • [ ] Security gate workflow green (security-gate.yml)
  • [ ] PR bot comments addressed

docs.title: Release & Operations
docs.text:
• [ ] EPSS refresh job healthy (nightly)
  • [ ] Remediation tickets created with CVE/CVSS/EPSS context
  • [ ] Logging & monitoring alerts wired (no silent failures)
